_comment: LAYER 2 — consultation fee data for the FICTIONAL Wellness Point Clinic demo. DUMMY / PLACEHOLDER values only. Mirrors data/canopy_commercial.json's is_dummy convention. The agent must ALWAYS speak these as indicative, confirmed by the front desk — never as a final bill.
fee_basis: Fees are indicative and vary by exact procedure complexity and materials used; the front desk / doctor confirms the final amount. Follow-up visits within the same treatment course may be charged differently.
payment_note: Cash, card and UPI are accepted at the clinic. Card/UPI/payment details are never collected over a phone call.
disclaimer: Indicative only. Exact fees depend on the specific procedure, materials, and doctor's assessment at the visit, and are confirmed by the front desk — never quote a fee as final over the phone.
